name: ComfyUI Captioning
description: Auto-captioning with LLMs/JoyCaption and ComfyUI custom workflow nodes. Captioning GGUF models can be downloaded from HuggingFace via the Caption Models settings page.
author: DeeplabSystems

volumes.description: ComfyUI custom-addons folder (where comfyui-sdcodex nodes will be installed)
Directory where captioning models (GGUF + mmproj) downloaded from the Caption Models page are stored
Read-only mount of your LM Studio models directory (point host_path at your LM Studio models folder) so the app can read those GGUF models
